LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.3 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Vocabulary Expansion • Fluency (speed an
Topic 2.7: Guided Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Reading. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What clues can help you comprehend a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite key words, expressions and phrasesin simple texts
2. show awareness of the importance of correct articulation when reading texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED READING
This lesson teaches Guided Reading for Grade 5 MANDARIN.

STUDY STEPS
1. recite key words, expressions and phrasesin simple texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. show awareness of the importance of correct articulation when reading texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Reading using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Reading above.
2. Explain Guided Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Reading.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Reading with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Reading important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What clues can help you comprehend a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recite key words, expressions and phrasesin simple texts
2. show awareness of the importance of correct articulation when reading texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
